proposals.action_title: Upload First 40-Page Coloring Book to Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline is ready. Using Runware PAYG (20€) or Together AI (free tier) allows generation of 40 high-quality FLUX-schnell black and white outlines. KDP allows zero-cost publishing with immediate global distribution.
proposals.first_action_today: Trigger the 'produce_coloring_book' GitHub Actions workflow using Together AI to output a print-ready 40-page PDF.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 50 Minimalist Text Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble has high organic traffic for niche humor, quotes, and literal idioms. Using the 'produce_quotes_minimal' or 'produce_literal_idioms' pipeline, Hugo can generate 50 transparent PNGs via Python in Termux/GitHub Actions and upload them quickly using Redbubble's template system on his phone's browser.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 50 transparent PNG quote designs via Termux using a Python PIL script and save them to a GitHub Release.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Parametric 3D Printing STL Files on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D has a highly active audience looking for functional, printable items. Running the 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline using Gemini to write OpenSCAD scripts for household fixes (drawer dividers, phone stands, custom hooks) provides immediate, non-copyrighted utility value.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 3 OpenSCAD designs via Gemini, convert them to STL files using GitHub Actions, and upload them to Cults3D priced at 1.50€ to 2.50€.

proposals.action_title: Launch 5 Aesthetic Grid Notebooks on KDP using Runware FLUX Covers
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content grid notebooks require minimal interior setup (simple repetitive PDF generated via Python). The differentiator is a stunning, niche-specific cover. Using FLUX-schnell via Runware (fractions of a cent per image) ensures eye-catching cover graphics.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a standard 120-page 6x9 graph paper interior PDF using a short Python script in Termux.

proposals.action_title: List a Seamless Textures Asset Pack on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly search itch.io for affordable, high-quality seamless textures (sci-fi, fantasy, medieval). Using FLUX-schnell with 'seamless tiling' prompts yields high-quality 2D assets that can be sold as a pack for $2.99.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 20 seamless fantasy stone and wood textures using Together AI / Runware, package them into a zip, and create a free itch.io seller page.

proposals.action_title: Implement High-Intent Keyword Optimization for KDP Listings
proposals.why_this_works_now: With zero marketing budget, organic search is the only driver. Using the Amazon search bar auto-suggest (via mobile browser in desktop mode) to find long-tail keywords (e.g. 'mindful coloring book for teen girls') boosts organic rank overnight.
proposals.first_action_today: Search Amazon for your book's primary niche, extract 7 highly specific search phrases, and insert them into the KDP backend keyword fields.
